summary: Owners can archive a physical group and restore it through Undo or the board Archive. Both controls call store::transition_group under current selected-board access. The transaction changes only the group's state and revision and the board revision. Archived groups, including empty ones, have their own ordered recovery pages.
evidence: All 31 browser_preview journeys passed serially in owned headless Chromium. The final run included the 28 inherited journeys and all three packet 38 journeys.

browser_archives_and_restores_one_group: Escape issued no write. While the board was locked, the old grid remained visible and a second menu gesture issued no POST. Archiving g-90 hid 73, 61 and 77; Undo at board/3 returned them in place while 67 remained individually archived. A second removal, Dismiss, history traversal and reload did not recreate Undo or replay the command. Durable Restore used board/5. The recovery list showed Retired and the removed Work before restore, then only Retired, blocked item 57 and restorable item 67. Fresh connections compared complete board, group, item and receipt records, session and grants at each checkpoint.

browser_recovers_failed_group_lifecycle: a deferred group-update fault returned 500 with the pre-attempt snapshot intact and no Undo. An explicit retry succeeded. After a peer advanced the board revision, stale Restore returned 409. Reload recovery list issued only a GET. The next click committed at baseline 4; an injected 503 on the following board GET offered reload, and the recovery read showed the accepted state without another POST.

browser_demoted_owner_cannot_restore_group: demotion after the enabled Restore rendered produced one 403 followed by an authorized recovery GET. Member and Viewer had disabled group transitions; only Member retained ordinary name editing. Withdrawing membership denied the destination, and revoking the session returned to sign-in.

All 25 loopback_board_access cases passed. The two new cases covered role, session, grant, active board/workspace, route and board-local group checks; repeated migration of a populated v8 fixture; one winner on competing connections; stale-repeat rejection; rollback over the 500-row grid limit; and the unchanged full item and receipt records. A 102-group archive returned pages of 100 and 2 in position/ID order, including an empty restorable group beyond page one. An old continuation conflicted after restore.

Locked workspace tests passed (40 tests), along with workspace formatting and git diff --check. Builds used target-browser-packets. Node runner regressions were denied by worker shell policy before execution. Cross-visit late group acknowledgments were guarded by the mount identity but not separately fault-injected.
